CHIKUNGUNYA.title: Chikungunya (virus spread by mosquitoes)

items: Chikungunya is a viral illness spread by mosquito bites.
Its main feature is painful joints.
Sudden fever, often above 39 degrees C.
Pain in many joints on both sides of the body, which can be severe.
Headache, muscle pain, rash, and sometimes red eyes.
A PCR test on blood in the first week of illness.
An IgM antibody test, usually positive towards the end of the first week.
A dengue test, since the two infections can look alike.
Your doctor will advise on treatment and on relief of symptoms.
Ask your doctor what is safe for pain and fever.

sections.h: What you can do at home
items: Rest and drink plenty of fluids.
Use mosquito protection to avoid further bites.
Joint pain can last for some time. See your doctor if it is not getting better.
This leaflet gives general information. Follow your doctor's advice.

urgent: The source entry lists no specific emergency sign for this condition.
Get urgent help if you feel suddenly much worse.
